priorAsBuilt.note: Attributed the 12.8x miss on gen-delta-1000-parts to 1000 appends going through editor.apply. That cardinality claim does not hold on this checkout: the yielding harness does 3 applies, the no-yield stream does 1.

points.name: streaming 1000 gen-delta parts at 100/sec
points.diagnosis: The clock is 100 setTimeout(0) macrotasks (yield every 10 tokens). Same-run yield-floor p50 is 114.99ms. Coalesced no-yield work is 0.13ms and one apply. The 50ms flush window elapses during the yields, so this harness does 3 applies, not 1000.

points.name: streaming batch flush latency
points.diagnosis: The timed window is one appendDelta plus one setTimeout(0). timedApplyCount is 0; the apply happens in endStreaming after b.end().

coalescedNoYield.note: Same 1000 appendDeltas + endStreaming without the 100 macrotask yields. This is the work a 10ms CPU target can describe. Recorded, not gated.
